senses.en: a business that sells goods or services

example.en: She works for a software company.
example.zh: 她在一家软件公司工作。

senses.en: the state of being with other people

example.en: I enjoy his company.
example.zh: 我喜欢有他作伴。

senses.en: people who are visiting someone

example.en: We are expecting company for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐有客人来。

senses.en: a group of actors, dancers, or musicians who work together

example.en: The theater company is touring Europe.
example.zh: 这个剧团正在欧洲巡演。

senses.en: to tell people something officially or publicly

example.en: The company announced a new policy yesterday.
example.zh: 公司昨天宣布了一项新政策。

senses.en: to introduce a person or program on radio, TV, or at an event

example.en: She announced the next guest on the radio show.
example.zh: 她在广播节目中介绍了下一位嘉宾。

senses.en: to be a sign that something is coming or present

example.en: Dark clouds announced the coming storm.
example.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

senses.en: the part of the body joining the head to the shoulders

example.en: She wore a thin scarf around her neck.
example.zh: 她在脖子上围了一条薄围巾。

senses.en: a narrow part of a container or garment opening

example.en: The bottle's neck was too narrow for the brush.
example.zh: 瓶口太窄，刷子伸不进去。

senses.en: to kiss and caress someone amorously

example.en: The couple were necking on the sofa.
example.zh: 那对情侣在沙发上搂抱亲吻。

senses.en: the son of your brother or sister, or of your spouse's brother or sister

example.en: My nephew stayed with us for the weekend.
example.zh: 我侄子周末和我们住在一起。

senses.en: the shared customs, beliefs, and way of life of a group of people
senses.zh: 一个群体共享的习俗、信仰和生活方式

example.en: Food is an important part of every culture.
example.zh: 食物是每种文化的重要组成部分。

senses.en: the arts, ideas, and intellectual activity valued by a society
senses.zh: 社会所重视的艺术、思想和智力活动

example.en: She studied French literature and culture at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习法国文学和文化。

senses.en: a growth of microorganisms or cells in a controlled setting
senses.zh: 在受控环境中培养的微生物或细胞

example.en: The lab examined a culture of bacteria under a microscope.
example.zh: 实验室在显微镜下检查了细菌培养物。

senses.en: to grow microorganisms or cells in a controlled medium
senses.zh: 在受控培养基中培养微生物或细胞

example.en: Scientists culture the cells in a nutrient-rich solution.
example.zh: 科学家在营养丰富的溶液中培养这些细胞。

senses.en: a feeling of happiness or enjoyment

example.en: It gave me great pleasure to see her again.
example.zh: 再次见到她让我非常高兴。

senses.en: something that gives enjoyment

example.en: Reading is one of life's simple pleasures.
example.zh: 阅读是生活中的简单乐趣之一。

senses.en: to give someone sexual pleasure

example.en: He tried to pleasure his partner.
example.zh: 他试图给伴侣带来快感。

senses.en: responsibility for a mistake or problem

example.en: It was my fault that we missed the train.
example.zh: 我们错过火车是我的过错。

senses.en: a defect or problem in something

example.en: The mechanic found a fault in the brake system.
example.zh: 机械师发现刹车系统有故障。

senses.en: to criticize or blame someone for something

example.en: She faulted him for not warning her.
example.zh: 她责怪他没有提醒她。

senses.en: a crack in the Earth's crust along which rock has moved

example.en: The map shows several active faults.
example.zh: 地图上标出了几条活动断层。

senses.en: to say what you think is true without being sure

example.en: I guess she is still at work.
example.zh: 我猜她还在上班。

senses.en: an attempt to answer or estimate without sure knowledge

example.en: My guess is that the meeting will be cancelled.
example.zh: 我猜会议会被取消。
